Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

^ PURCHASER'S DATA SHEET FOR 

^SOLID BOWL SCROLL DISCHARGE CENTRIFUGES 



1. Scope — Covers the technical data to be supplied by a purchaser while placing an enquiry or' 
order to a supplier for the purchase of a solid bowl scroll discharge centrifuge. 

2. Purchaser's Data Sheet 




Feed 

1. Name of material being processed 

2. Feed rate... . kg/h 

3. Physical properties 

a ) Temperature °C b ) Viscosity cP at °C 

c ) Specific gravity 

4. Composition 

a ) Fraction of solids in feed percent 

b ) Fraction of liquid in feed percent 

5. pH 

Solids 



6. Name 

7. Nature of solids ( crystalline/amorphous/fibrous/sticky ) 

8. If fibrous, length of fibre .,,..,. 

9. If crystalline, shape of crystals 

10. Sieve designation and aperture: Percent mass between sieves: 



(If exact analysis is not available, 5 kg of the representative sample may be sent for the 
determination of sieve analysis ). 

11. Bulk density 

12. Specific gravity 

Mother Liquor 



13. Name 

14. Physical properties: 
a ) Specific gravity. 

15. pH 



b) Viscosity cP at.

Other Information

a) Volts b) Phase

a ) Length m b ) Breadth m 

c ) Height m 

Note — A pencil sketch showing headroom, floor space and desired space for centrifuging 
in relation to other equipment may be submitted along with a flow sheet of the process indi- 
cating where the separation stage or stages are required. 



34. Any special requirements. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The information given by a purchaser according to this data sheet will enable a manufacturer 
or supplier to assess the exact requirements of the purchaser and recommend to him the most suitable 
type of equipment. (
